title: Add derived artifact schema

context.summary: Add the database and repository foundation for recomputable derived document artifacts.
context.background: TASK-37 added a model runtime boundary. Multimodal document processing now needs durable derived-state tables that never mutate RAW originals and can support text/OCR/transcript/image/frame/face artifacts in later tasks.

in: Add a separate derived artifact migration after the immutable baseline schema.
Add processing run, document artifact, artifact vector, text span, media metadata, metadata index, face identity and face observation tables.
Represent derived artifact tables in Drizzle schema and relations.
Add core artifact contracts and a DB repository boundary for derived artifact writes.
Update migration runner to apply multiple migrations without changing the 0000 checksum.
Document the derived-state model and RAW original immutability.
out: Implement OCR, ASR, image, video or face processors.
Expose artifact APIs, CLI commands or MCP tools.
Backfill derived artifacts for existing documents.

acceptance_criteria: A new migration creates derived artifact tables without modifying 0000_initial_schema.
Derived tables are project/document scoped and cascade with their owning document/project.
The schema can store processing run fingerprints, source refs, artifact payload pointers, text spans, media metadata and workspace-scoped face observations.
RAW document originals remain represented only by document storage keys; derived artifacts use separate tables and optional storage keys.
@mindory/core exports artifact contracts and @mindory/db exports a derived artifact repository.
The migration runner can apply 0000 and 0001 sequentially.

manual_checks: Confirm derived artifact tables do not store or mutate RAW original blobs.

risks: Changing the baseline migration would break existing checksum validation; keep new schema in 0001.
Future processors must treat derived artifacts as rebuildable projections and not as canonical RAW storage.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
